chapter_note: A heavily substratic chapter: a tightly structured cosmological-eschatological teaching on the Three Great Days (First Man's descent/return, Fathers of Light enthroned in new aeon, Father's final unveiling) and Two Deaths (mixture-period and final separation). The dialogue frame (apostle/disciples) is confined to a small opening section (i=3-11). The 'Once again' transitions inside the Days teaching (i=18) appear to function within substrate as structural connectives. Eschatological vocabulary like 'elect ones' (i=48) reads here as cosmic-eschatological rather than the contemporary church class. Heavy lacunae throughout but the surviving spine is recognizably the Persian/Bene-Qedem cosmological substrate. Editorial fatigue score is negative (later-layer vocabulary actually decreases in second half), confirming substrate dominance.
